linkedin.notes: Recommended first real adapter. Lower anti-bot friction than visual platforms.

facebook.notes: Higher anti-bot friction. Personal feed only, no groups in v1.

instagram.notes: Media-heavy. Requires square or vertical images.

reddit.notes: Subreddit rules vary wildly. Risk of bans for promotional content.

tiktok.notes: Video-first. Static image ads will underperform.

indeed.notes: Job board. Different format from social. May need separate ad pool.

snapchat.notes: Business/Ads Manager flow only; personal story posting is not reliably web-automatable.

bluesky.notes: DISABLED 2026-08-03 by Dave: no Bluesky account exists. Adapter is written and works via the open AT Protocol API if an account is ever created.
